title: 2nd Grade for ME - Unit 3
before:
In Unit 3, students will learn about important topics in hands-on and meaningful ways. With support from their teachers, students examine books, pictures, artwork, and ideas closely to gain a deeper understanding of the world around them. Children explore science and engineering, learn about Maine’s history and communities, and work with new and familiar materials. Through projects, students share their thinking and show what they have learned in creative and exciting ways.

notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.
2487 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Make a bold line a real heading
decisions.why: "Family Links" is a paragraph in bold type. It reads as a heading and is spaced like one, but it is not in the page's outline, a screen reader does not announce it, and the contents list cannot link to it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 46 links on this page open a file — 46 PowerPoint — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 17 list items open with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Let a colon do its own work
decisions.why: A colon marks the words before it as a term and the words after it as what the term means. 20 links sit immediately in front of a colon, where the chevron lands between the term and the punctuation that belongs to it. 1 format tag stands between a title and its description and moves to the end of the row. No word changes and nothing is removed.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: In Unit 3, students will learn about important topics in hands-on and meaningful ways. With support from their teachers, students examine books, pictures, artwork, and ideas closely to gain a deeper understanding of the world around them. Children explore science and engineering, learn about Maine’s history and communities, and work with new and familiar materials. Through projects, students share their thinking and show what they have learned in creative and exciting ways.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.
decisions.removes: 2nd Grade for ME - Unit 3 - Connecting Places Connecting People.png

decisions.label: Put the page’s one action in the banner
decisions.why: This page opens with a paragraph holding nothing but "Unit 3 Supplemental Text List" — the first thing it asks you to do, set as a line of body text. The banner has a place for exactly that, so it moves there as a button. The link and its words are unchanged; only where it sits changes.
